title: Kitchen Renovation Side by Side
tests: Composes two supplied photos into one correctly ordered, clearly labeled comparison without regenerating either scene.

faults.what: The photos were altered rather than simply fitted. Both views show additional lower cabinetry and flooring beyond the supplied images, and their framing and proportions have changed.
The finished canvas is slightly wider than the requested 16:9 aspect ratio.

judge.summary: The comparison has clear labels and the correct left-right order, but it changes the supplied photos instead of preserving them.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both supplied kitchen photos side by side.
must_haves.why: There is one side-by-side image, but its canvas is slightly wider than 16:9 and the panels are altered versions of the photos.

must_haves.item: The brown-cabinet kitchen is on the left and the white-cabinet renovated kitchen is on the right.
must_haves.why: The kitchen views are in the correct order.

must_haves.item: The left panel is labeled exactly 'Before' and the right panel exactly 'After', with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: Both labels are correctly spelled, prominent, and fully visible.

must_haves.item: Both complete photos remain visible without stretching or changes to their contents.
must_haves.why: The panels change the original framing and proportions and add visible areas, including flooring and lower cabinetry, that were not present in the supplied photos.
